title: Staged acceptance harness for batching + cache adoption with operator checkpoints
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design and implement a staged acceptance harness for Optimize's batching/caching recommendations that enables safe auto-apply in production. The harness will combine shadow validation, phased traffic ramp, operator approval checkpoints, and automated rollback criteria derived from telemetry deltas. Goal: reduce manual rollout friction while keeping latency and quality regressions below SLOs.
comments: 2026-02-16 - Kickoff: scoped MVP to support KV-cache and batch-size profile changes only. Excluded: kernel/quantization changes for initial phase.

2026-02-18 - Decision: use shadow traffic runner to validate candidate config for 24h against representative traffic with token-level telemetry capture. Trade-off: longer validation vs faster savings capture.
2026-02-23 - Engineering spike completed: built proof-of-concept that can replay 10k reqs/min through candidate runtime in shadow with <10% CPU overhead on pilot cluster.

2026-02-26 - Design review (PM + SRE): operator checkpoints added at two gates: pre-canary approval and pre-global-apply. Both require an explicit human ack unless policy allows auto-approve for low-risk thresholds.

2026-02-28 - Feedback from Research: add quality evaluation hooks (prompt set Evals) to detect small divergence in outputs for chat endpoints. Action: integrate eval-runner into shadow validation pipeline.
2026-03-01 - PR #redwood/infra/optimize-harness opened: implements shadow runner, telemetry diffs, and a web UI for operator approvals. Seeking API design feedback.

2026-03-02 - SLO trade-off discussion: suggested guardrail: latency P95 must not regress >10ms and token-error-rate delta <0.2% during canary window. Ops pushed back asking for dynamic thresholds by model family.
2026-03-03 - Action items: (1) add model-family adaptive thresholds, (2) wire audit logs to Private deployments audit stream, (3) add an emergency fast-rollback button to console.
2026-03-03 - Blocker noted: Dedicated clusters with strict CIDR egress cannot reach telemetry ingestion endpoint. Solution: add a VPC egress proxy path; SRE to coordinate.
